message.standandhold.growth_complete: Outpost expanded. Buildings, storage and defender limits unchanged.
gui.standandhold.growth_preserved: No extra cost, refill or defender slots.
gui.standandhold.tip.expand: Expand this checkpoint once after local level 2. Rechecks terrain now; replaces 88 ground cells. No typed token needed.

gui.standandhold.growth_status.5: Paused: terrain or building checks failed.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.6: Paused: entities obstruct the expansion area.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.7: Paused: interrupted operation needs admin review.
gui.standandhold.growth_status.8: Growth unavailable: saved data needs review.
tooltip.standandhold.player_targets: Player hits can hurt any mob, including human units
tooltip.standandhold.player_equipment_fr: Players can use found gear at any stage
gui.standandhold.deployment.0: Slots open; spawn checks still apply
gui.standandhold.deployment.2: Dormant Main Base; stage gate not reached
gui.standandhold.deployment.3: No unit unlocked at this human stage
gui.standandhold.deployment.4: Post full; assigned units reserve slots
message.standandhold.main_base_dormant: Main Base command dormant: requires human stage %s. Lab/crate remain usable.

gui.standandhold.tip.export: Export %s local supplies to the global bank.

gui.standandhold.tip.start_research: Start the selected research. Costs are spent only at completion.
gui.standandhold.tip.pause_research: Pause without losing saved work or storage.

tooltip.standandhold.friendly_safe: Players and allied teams are protected.
